audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 5 read "Skill" and row 6 gives Yasuo the 2-item bracket, all three disagreeing with the already-audited mirror (vayne__yasuo), which set rows 3 and 5 to Yasuo and row 6 to Vayne.
audit.why: Row 6 as Yasuo also contradicts this page's own carry threat of 9.5/10 and Vayne's Silver Bolts scaling. whys[3] and whys[5] already describe Yasuo winning those brackets, so the "Skill" rows contradicted the prose beside them.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 5 and 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group (Yasuo / Yasuo / Vayne), ratings moved with them, and the late-game prose rewritten so it agrees with row 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page described the 2-item stage as Yasuo's, which inverts the real spike order: Yasuo spikes on levels 3-6 and first item, Vayne spikes on stacked crit and Final Hour.
audit.why: Final Hour is 100/85/70s and halves Tumble's already short 6/5/4/3/2s cooldown while giving invisibility during it; Silver Bolts has no cooldown at all.
audit.corrected: spikes[3].text, late, whys[6] and phases[6].why rewritten to place the flip at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions absent: Silver Bolts' third hit is max-health TRUE damage (so armour is the wrong purchase), and Tumble is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Several do/don't bodies were also generic filler that did not match their own titles.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags both (resistances-invalidated, autoreset-burst-tell). Condemn is a projectile at 550 range on 20/18/16/14/12s and Wind Wall deletes it for 4s on a 25s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now carries the projectile rule with the 4s/25s numbers, dosFull[2].d gives the Tumble reset tell, dontsFull[1].d states the true-damage rule, and late says armour is the wrong answer.
